name: EfficientNet 特征检测
description: 使用 EfficientNet deep 特征 以检测 AI生成的 and manipulated images through learned representations.
algorithm: Transfer Learning with EfficientNet-B0 for Synthetic Image Detection
mechanism: This forensic leviathan refuses to count simple pixels like archaic 20th-century scanners. It sadistically devours 100% of the visual canvas, hurling it violently through a hyper-dense Weights Matrix of 100+ 2D Convolutional layers. Generative 'Latent Space' structural failures or denoising fingerprints left foolishly behind by GANs and Diffusion immediately trigger catastrophic alarms deep within EfficientNet’s routing. It spits out a cold, terminal execution sentence based on raw classification probability.
parameters: Architecture: EfficientNet-B0, Input: 224×224, Features: 1280-dim, Pooling: global average, Classifier: FC
source: Bonettini, N. et al. (2021) — Video Face Manipulation Detection Through Ensemble of CNNs, ICPR
useCase: High-准确度 检测 of AI生成的 images using deep 神经网络 特征

references.title: Bonettini, N. et al. (2021) — Video Face Manipulation Detection Through Ensemble of CNNs, ICPR

strengths:
• State-of-the-art 检测 准确度
• Learns complex 篡改 模式
• Transfer learning reduces training needs
• Ensemble-friendly architecture
limitations:
• 需要GPU进行高效推理
• 可能无法泛化到未见过的生成器
• 黑箱决策
• 模型体积大
